content.short: OMY Payments is a crypto payment gateway that lets businesses accept and settle payments in crypto.
content.description: OMY Payments is a crypto payment gateway and processor for businesses, accepting assets such as BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC and settling globally in minutes at lower fees than card networks. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists OMY Payments.
content.meta: OMY Payments is a crypto payment gateway for businesses accepting USDT, USDC, BTC and more, listed on Plasma.
